personal.name: Roger Oliva
personal.generalBio: I am Roger Oliva Rodríguez, a fullstack developer specialized in frontend development and a fourth-year Computer Engineering student, with two years of hands-on experience building web and mobile interfaces that balance performance, clean architecture, and visual excellence. Guided by continuous learning and self-taught integration of UX/UI principles, I stand out for my rigorous approach to project delivery, high adaptability to agile environments, and ease of collaboration in multidisciplinary teams. My goal is to join innovative ecosystems where I can leverage my expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript to build scalable and maintainable solutions, always delivering quality code and solid digital experiences that create real impact for the business and the end user.

projectsList.title: SunTravels
projectsList.description: Complete web platform for SunTravels, a travel agency specializing in Cuba. Features i18n landing page (es/en) with destination catalog, services, tours, OpenPay reservations, blog, testimonials, inquiry form, and administrative backoffice for bookings and operations.

projectsList.title: DConceptos App
projectsList.description: Mobile application for architectural quotes and project management: clients submit requests, technicians inspect and adjust data, generating invoices and deliverables. Includes project chat, phases, specialties, and cloud sync.

projectsList.title: eCTD Regulatory Dossier Management System
projectsList.description: Centralized regulatory dossier management system (eCTD) for the Cuban biopharmaceutical industry. Automates consolidation, traceability, and version control of dossiers under ICH standards. Includes document/structural template management, SGD integration, and ZIP export ensuring regulatory compliance (CECMED, FDA, EMA).

projectsList.title: ALCOM
projectsList.description: Commercial management system for Havana's water company. Developed with React, TypeScript, Vite, MobX, and Material UI, allowing banking management, billing, client contracting, commercial operations, and interactive dashboard reporting.

projectsList.title: Biocu App
projectsList.description: Comprehensive mobile platform for environmental awareness and management in Cuba. Developed with Flutter and NestJS, enabling citizens to report environmental incidents in real-time, manage requests via a robust API, and access educational content on environmental regulations.

experiencesList.description: Member of the frontend team responsible for continuous enhancement of the commercial management system currently in production. Building scalable web applications with React, Next.js, and Node.js, implementing serverless architectures and performance optimizations.

Development team member creating tourism management systems, providing web and mobile solutions for corporate clients. Responsible for evolution and maintenance of mobile apps in production, with a continuous focus on performance optimization and user experience (UX).
Specialization in software development and system architecture. Thesis project focused on scalable web applications.
